title.en: An Act to Rescind the Assessments of Certain Land Reclaimed By the Government By Dredging or Filling in the City of Manila, Made Until Date Under Act Numbered Sixteen Hundred and Fifty-Four, to Provide for a Reappraisal thereof, and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
The assessments made until date by the Director of Lands and approved by the Secretary of the
Interior, under the provisions of Act Numbered Sixteen hundred and fifty-four, of the land making up the lots
or parcels of land reclaimed by the Government by dredging or filling in the city of Manila, are hereby made
subject to reappraisal whenever the Secretary of Agriculture and Natural Resources shall see fit to instruct the
Director of Lands to make a new appraisal of such land, in the manner provided in subsection (ft) of section
two of said Act: Provided, however, That this section shall not apply to any lots or parcels at present leased or
to which the Government has granted a right of lease.

Any person, association or corporation which, on the date when this Act shall take effect, shall
have any of such lots or parcels under lease and not be in arrears or have violated any of the conditions of the
lease, may petition the Secretary of Agriculture and Natural Resources, within ninety days from and after the
approval of this Act, for a reconsideration of the assessment of their respective lots or parcels; and the
Director of Lands may, with the approval of the Secretary of Agriculture and Natural Resources, make a new
appraisal, and said lease may be revised in accordance therewith: Provided, however, That in such case it shall
not be necessary to readvertise the land for lease.

All leases executed or revised in accordance with this Act shall be subject to the provisions of
section two of Act Numbered Sixteen hundred and fifty-four, with the sole exception that the first reappraisal
prescribed therein shall be made upon the expiration of five years after the date of such execution or revision.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, February 15, 1918.
